column1: # note: One row for each region. r1_mhz
column2: r2_mhz and r3_mhz list the channels of each rate
column3: apart by spaces; an empty list means the region has no channel at that rate. The order of the channels (R1
column6: each list in its order) is the order of preference: at a rate too low for every channel
column7: the stack takes the first channels that fit. centre_mhz is the frequency to tune: the centre of the capture that holds every channel
column8: as the stack plans it (the middle of the channels); the stack asks for the least rate that holds every channel. A host sets the tuned frequency to centre_mhz in Hz and the setting channels of the stack to every channel as frequency in Hz / rate. lr_mhz lists the Z-Wave Long Range channels (100 kbit/s DSSS-OQPSK)
column10: not decoded by the stack. countries lists the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries that use the region
column11: apart by spaces; a host picks the row of a country by it.
